EGY.note: The document states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms.
AI in real estate registration is only a stated future aim, not a system in use or being tested.
AI for real estate is named only as a future aim of the Ministry of Justice; no tool is piloted or in service.
No AI model, dataset or AI computing built or hosted in Egypt is stated.

facts.fact: Egypt's Ministry of Justice says it has activated a unified digital platform on which citizens complete property registration remotely from application through payment to e-signature.

EGY.note: The document names no e-commerce or electronic transactions law, draft or rules.
